article.story: ST. LOUIS -- — Trey Green had 22 points in Saint Louis’ 125-63 win over Northern Kentucky on Tuesday. Green shot 7 for 8 from beyond the arc for the Billikens (3-0). Kellen Thames and Amari McCottry each scored 18 points, and Thames added seven rebounds. B.J. Davis-Ray led the way for the Norse (2-2) with 13 points and six rebounds. Northern Kentucky also got 10 points from Noah Pagotto. Saint Louis took the lead with 18:17 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Ishan Sharma led his team in scoring with 16 points in the first half to go up 56-24 at the break. Saint Louis extended its lead to 81-35 during the second half, fueled by a 9-0 scoring run. Green scored a team-high 12 points after the break to close out the win. Up next Saint Louis plays High Point at home on Sunday, and Northern Kentucky will host Central Michigan on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
